rule: Challenger features fill only features that are unobserved in the frozen Production request; Production-observed features are never overwritten. Same mapping weights; ranking = ZAI_WIN.
primary: paired top-3 mean rank gain (PROD - arm), positive = challenger better

evidence_rule.venue_rule: promote needs >= 2 decisive venue x surface cells improving and none degrading

promotion_eligible: >= 100 forward races, venue_rule CONSISTENT_IMPROVEMENT, mean gain > 0; adoption only by Owner decision (12/7 or 12/28)
a4: Any A4 ERROR (provider parse failure, unknown venue code, missing post time, PROD replay mismatch, result annotation inside a pre-race capture) is recorded per race; races with A4 errors are reported and excluded from promotion evidence until explained.
